title: Nice Small Fridge, but a little too small
text: Nice Small Fridge, but a little too small. Nice looking fridge.  Reversible door is nice, but looks like a little bit of work to get it reversed to swing the other direction.  Runs reasonably quiet.  Maybe adequate for a dorm room, but otherwise just too small to hold much of anything.  I didn't realize it was quite so small when I ordered it.  The door will hold just one two liter bottle of soda.  The freezer compartment will fit maybe two ice cube trays and that's about it.  Overall will hold only about 12 cans of soda.  Not sure if it is big enough to hold a leftover pizza in the box.  Would not be big enough for a small apartment.  Not sure if this is frost free; I don't think it is, so you might have to defrost the freezer once in a while.  If you just want this as an additional fridge to hold a few extra things that you don't want in your full sized fridge, this might be idea for you.  Or if you only have a limited number of things that you want to keep cold, it will work for you also.

【ADJUSTABLE MECHANICAL THERMOSTAT CONTROL】Walsh refrigerator can be controlled manually with the control dial from cool to cold to coldest, you can turn the knob to set the temperature you want. And the temperature range for refrigerator compartment is 32℉ to 47℉, chiller compartment is 27℉ to 37℉.

【REVERSIBLE DOORS & LEVELING FRONT LEGS】 Reversible door that can open from left or right, reversible door that can be suitable for different kitchen layout. Leveling legs can adjust feet and keep level placement in anywhere.
【ENERGY-SAVING】 Compact refrigerator uses R600 a high-efficiency and low-energy consumption compressor, it can cool food quickly with lower energy.
【PACKAGE INCLUDES】 1 * Refrigerator; 1 * Coated Wire Slide-Out Shelf; 1 * Power Cord.
